{"text": "The `make_requirement_preparer` function is a class method of the `RequirementCommand` class.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The `make_requirement_preparer` function creates and configures an instance of the `RequirementPreparer` class.", "type": "intent"},
{"text": "The `make_requirement_preparer` function takes a temporary build directory, command-line options, a build tracker, a session object, a package finder, and flags for using the user site and enabling lazy wheel downloads as parameters.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The `make_requirement_preparer` function determines whether to use the legacy resolver or the resolvelib resolver based on the provided options.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "The `make_requirement_preparer` function relies on the helper method `determine_resolver_variant` to decide which resolver to use.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The `make_requirement_preparer` function logs warnings when experimental features are enabled with the legacy resolver.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "The `make_requirement_preparer` function returns an instance of `RequirementPreparer` configured with all the provided parameters.", "type": "dataflow"},
{"text": "The `make_requirement_preparer` function does not handle errors or exceptions itself.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "The `make_requirement_preparer` function has no side effects beyond creating and returning a new object, aside from logging warnings about experimental feature usage.", "type": "behavioural"}
]
